name: Traditional Agua de Horchata (Soothing Rice Milk, Cinnamon & Sugar)
whyItWorks: Traditional agua fresca crafted from ground white rice steeped in water with Mexican canela cinnamon and sugar. Creamy, cooling, and completely dairy-free (verify with the taqueria that they don't add condensed milk).
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask: 'Is your horchata made traditionally with rice and water, or does it have cow's milk/dairy added?' If dairy-free, enjoy slowly over ice.
